atoms.pair_rank_encoding: 240 rows of 240 single-digit exact F2 ranks, support index 2*normal+trimmed

conclusion.eight_term_obstruction: Every term must meet every frame, excluding every rank-seven atom.
conclusion.nine_term_obstruction: Nine rank-seven atoms require nine distinct pairwise nonorthogonal live trimmed endpoints; maximum is eight.
conclusion.scope: Exact C(alpha)/N(alpha) supports on this P112; any finite term count and arbitrary real or complex coefficients; additional zero-cost terms permitted. No arbitrary proper sub-supports or new kappa.
